settings.title: Sensor Watch
settings.subtitle: Monitors Zigbee nodes via Homey's node list (same as Developer Tools → Zigbee).
settings.where_app: App without devices. Find it under Apps → Sensor Watch on Homey Pro 2.
settings.watch_model_ids_help: Default: ["lumi.weather","lumi.sensor*","(empty)"] — * is a wildcard; (empty) = older nodes with no Model ID.
settings.stale_after_hours_help: If Zigbee lastSeen is older than this, send push (repeated daily while still missing).
settings.check_interval_help: The app checks often; push for the same stale device is sent at most once per day.
settings.notification_user_help: Same Homey mobile push as EV Charge Planner (push_text to the phone).
settings.push_api_token_help: Same local API key as EV Charge Planner (Developer Tools, Flow scope). Imported from EV automatically if missing.
settings.device_toggle_help: Enable/disable check per device. Off = no push for that device.
